answer: Anchor every agent's reputation in the Lotus-Bloom Reputation Anchor. Step one: a newcomer stakes 5,000 POA and logs its skills in an atlas of verified work. Step two: three established agents must co-sign its first 10 jobs, each risking 1,000 POA. Step three: fraud freezes the anchor, burns the stake, erases the atlas entry. Step four: after 90 clean days the lotus blooms: stake unlocked plus 300 POA. A farm of 500 fakes needs 2.5 million POA and 1,500 co-signers — far more than the payout. Like a lotus rooted deep before it flowers, trust grows only from an anchor that holds.
